properties.description:
Drives check_and_stamp against real files rather than through open_rocksdb, so it runs on the fast path.

Since 2026-09-08 it also carries the field-reported zero-instance case and the three controls that stop its fix becoming "always open": an UNKNOWN type still refuses and still says the binary is BEHIND; a retired type that IS populated still refuses, naming what it holds; and a population that CANNOT BE COUNTED still refuses, because a scan error read as zero would open the graph the guard exists to protect.

The zero-instance test was written against the unfixed code and observed to fail, reproducing the reporter's error text verbatim including the 0.50.0/0.55.1 version pair.

REGISTERED LATE, on the day the guard it tests locked a user out for the second time. The file existed and was outside the design record, so nothing connected it to the decision it enforces.
properties.name: tests/provenance.rs — which reflow2 wrote this graph, and the four controls that keep the retired-type refusal honest
